body:
lena: Hi folks - I'm putting in my resignation today. My last day will be 2026-08-14. I'm EU-based (Netherlands). Can we align on benefits cutover, local statutory continuation, data deletion requests, and the logistics for returning my laptop?
people-ops: Thanks for letting us know, Lena. We'll start the offboarding flow. Do you want an exit interview? Also, do you have any shares/equity vesting/option questions we should flag to comp?
lena: Yes to the exit interview on my last day AM if possible. I have RSUs vesting in Sep but not options. Please confirm how vesting works on departure.
sanjay: As your manager I approve the offboard and will attend the exit interview. Re: RSUs, Ill loop in comp for final confirmation but standard plan pro-rates unvested RSUs only in special cases.
it-ops: For hardware, please confirm asset list. We offer pre-paid dropoff via DHL in EU or scheduled pickup. Also advise when you'd like corporate Slack access revoked - typical is EOD local time but AWS keys revoked earlier.
lena: Company MacBook Air (tag 12345), travel adapter, and dongle. I'll use DHL dropoff. Keep Slack until EOD. Revoke AWS keys after final handoff meeting on 2026-08-12.
security: Note on data deletion: EU employees can request personal data erasure under local law. If you want us to purge personal data from our analytics and Slack export, please DM privacy@redwood and file a ticket by your last day. Also we need confirmation that you've rotated any secrets in shared vaults.
remo: I own the vaults. Lena, please list any secrets you control and I'll rotate them. If you want, I can take ownership of the remaining runbooks for a month.
lena: I'll inventory secrets and post in handoff doc (team drive link: https://drive.redwood/lena-handoff). I also want clarity on pension/retirement contributions cutover.
payroll-bot: Payroll notes: final salary run will process in next regular payroll after termination. Dutch statutory benefits: employer pension contributions stop on last day; we'll provide a statement for transfer. COBRA is US-specific and does not apply. For international employees, we provide country-specific continuation or local statutory notices where applicable.
people-ops: Action list:
- Lena: upload final handoff & secrets inventory (by 2026-08-05)
- IT: open asset-return DHL label and provide shipping instructions
- Security/Remo: rotate shared secrets and confirm in ticket
- Payroll: prepare final pay + pension statement and send country-specific benefits notes
- Comp (cc): confirm RSU treatment and any exercise windows if applicable
offboard-bot: Created offboard ticket OB-7820. Status: pending assets, pending benefits packet, exit-interview scheduled.
lena: Quick question on equity paperwork: who do I contact to check post-departure RSU settlement?
people-ops: We'll CC comp@redwood in the DM thread and ask them to confirm vesting/settlement timeline.
it-ops: DHL label created: DLH-789-NE. Dropoff or pickup options available. Please do not factory-reset until IT confirms receipt.
lena: Thanks - I'll drop off tomorrow and set exit interview for 10:00 CEST on 2026-08-14.
sanjay: Confirmed. I'll join. Thanks for your work, Lena.
people-ops: We'll follow up with DMs about data erasure form and send the benefits packet by EOD. Thanks everyone.
